name: Heca
goal:
Consolidare Heca come workspace compositor nativo, keyboard-first e pluggable, completando piattaforma terminale, architettura chrome/plugin, libreria grid-ui, integrazione Neovim GUI e rifiniture app/chrome.
The gates before any code
- §0 pre-flight, three written answers, per thing touched: which existing widget does this → if none, which planner task covers it (quote the id) → if neither, it is a proposal, not a commit.
- §0b widget vs component: if it can be built inside heca-grid-ui, it belongs there. A component only leaves the library because it binds an app concept.
- §0c the event system is DOM-shaped — capture → target → bubble, keys do bubble, a widget never hit-tests and never forwards, nothing focused means nothing delivered, and a cursor inside a container is not focus. Reach for a handler before an intent, a policy arm or a registry.
- ⭐⭐ Rule Zero: write the line a plugin author would type. A registry, an id or a crate-private type means the API is missing. HintTargetRegistry, HintTargets, HintTargetId, Base::hint_target, named_press are gone and must not come back.
description: Compositore di workspace GPU-native per sviluppatori, ispirato al layout a colonne scrollabili di Niri, che unifica terminali, editor e strumenti in una singola finestra accelerata via GPU. Think tmux meets Niri meets Neovide: terminali, editor e futuri container/plugin convivono nello stesso frame con animazioni fluide, testo nitido e chrome renderizzato via GPU.

projectGuidelines.content:
- do not fix at call site. Always try to fix at library (widget/ component) side.
- use css like syntax for laying down components: Flex, Grid, Surface etc...
- prefer composition and reusability. DO NOT HARDCODE anything.

acceptedDecisions.title: Public component authoring APIs expose ordinary constructors and children, without Box or casts
acceptedDecisions.decision: Public APIs used to author app, native-extension and described-plugin component trees must use ordinary component constructors, typed builders and child composition. They must not expose Box<dyn Component> as an authoring parameter or return value, require Box::new, trait-object casts, or explicit storage/type-erasure conversions merely to compose components. Allocation and type erasure are internal framework responsibilities. Public APIs and examples must let authors compose concrete components directly.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Antonio explicitly confirmed on 2026-10-24 that Box and casts must be removed from public APIs. This generalizes the existing Pane-specific authoring constraint without changing the decision that pane content is open component composition.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes:
Approved 2026-10-25: apply this ordinary constructor/fluent composition contract to ALL supported public native widgets/components, factories and return boundaries, not Terminal alone. Heterogeneous children may chain .child(a).child(b); shared child/metadata mechanisms and internal allocation are reused. Plugin identity handles remain acceptable; sandbox SDK descriptions and native live components expose equivalent capabilities without sharing runtime objects.
Centralized implementation: P067(F003)/T517 (moved intact from P052) fixes generic parts/templates first; P067/T398 then owns registry/model migration, public constructors including standalone Terminal::new("shell"), native binding and the exhaustive public-authoring acceptance. No caller boxing/casts/manual conversions or private host contexts.
P094 retains terminal-header composition (T450), managed creation/lifecycle/restore consuming that API (T452), float/input audits (T453/T455), second-content proof (T454) and picker convergence (T457). Do not make T398 depend back on T452. P106(F011)/T550 now owns real multi-document tabs and retains its T452 task prerequisite; do not block tabs on closure of all P094.
P052 retains T118/T122/T350 closeouts without duplicating the global API. T253/T305 remain deferred/on-demand; T251/T474/T520 and other completed foundations stay done. T360 review, F012 integration and P022 actual WASM loading/startup parity retain their owners. One canonical Provider/region reference is docs/widgets.md; other guides link there. Planner operations always use /Users/antonio/projects/heca/.planner. Task dependencies, task descriptions and the P067/P094 handoffs record the operational resume sequence; planning changes do not authorize implementation/task-start or claim runtime verification.
